docs.title: PsyScripts — Documentation
docs.meta: Documentation for all PsyScripts: attributes, examples and JS API.

docs.intro.one: {n} script, zero dependencies. Everything works through data attributes; the JS API is only for special cases.
docs.intro.other: {n} scripts, zero dependencies. Everything works through data attributes; the JS API is only for special cases.

docs.install.p: One line, bundle + css, or individually (core.min.js + dist/<name>.min.js). Styles (Tabs and icons included) live in psyscripts.min.css.
docs.core.p: Include core.min.js (already inside the bundle). Every script reads options from data attributes, PsyScripts.configure() or PsyScripts.opts(el, …).
docs.tabs.d: Accessible tabs: arrow keys, Home/End, roving tabindex.
docs.tabs.api: PsyScripts.Tabs.init(root, opts), .get(el) → {go(i), next(), prev(), index, destroy()}; event tabs:change
docs.tabs.o0: auto — arrows activate the tab; manual — Enter/click only
docs.tabs.a1: tab button; aria-selected="true" marks the default one
docs.tabs.a2: panel, same order as the buttons
docs.themeswitcher.d: Light/dark theme, localStorage, prefers-color-scheme. Sets data-theme on <html>.
docs.themeswitcher.o0: theme list; the toggle cycles through it
docs.headermenu.d: Responsive burger menu (below 860px); Esc and outside click close it.
docs.headermenu.o0: width (px) above which the menu closes
docs.headermenu.o3: hide the header when scrolling down
docs.copybutton.d: Copy text or an element's content, with a fallback for plain HTTP.
docs.copybutton.o1: text instead of the check icon
docs.copybutton.a3: show a Toast with this text
docs.scrollreveal.a0: enable; left / right change the direction
docs.accordion.d: Smooth accordion without max-height hacks (grid rows).
docs.modal.d: Modals on native <dialog>: Esc, focus trap, backdrop click.
docs.backtotop.api: Smooth scroll is disabled under reduced-motion.
docs.backtotop.o1: selector to scroll to (top by default)
docs.lazyimages.d: Lazy loading of img and srcset via IntersectionObserver.
docs.dropdown.d: Dropdown menu: arrow keys, Esc, focus return.
docs.dropdown.a0: wrapper; data-align="right" — open to the left
docs.tooltip.d: Tooltips on hover and focus, kept inside the screen.
docs.tooltip.api: PsyScripts.Tooltip.show(el), .hide(), .set(el, text). Esc and scrolling hide the tooltip.
docs.counter.api: PsyScripts.Counter.set(el, value, {duration, easing}), .run(el); custom curves: PsyScripts.Counter.easings.name = t => …
docs.counter.o1: linear | easeOutCubic | easeInOutCubic | easeOutExpo | easeOutBack | custom
docs.carousel.d: Scroll-snap carousel: arrows, dots, keyboard, autoplay.
docs.carousel.api: PsyScripts.Carousel.init(root, opts), .get(el) → {go(i), next(), prev(), play(), pause(), refresh(), destroy()}
docs.carousel.a0: root; data-autoplay="ms", data-multi — 2 slides on wide screens
docs.formvalidation.d: Native Constraint Validation API + ARIA, custom messages.
docs.formvalidation.o1: re-check on every input after an error
docs.formvalidation.a0: on <form>; + data-ajax — fires psy:valid instead of submitting
docs.scrollspy.d: Highlights the menu link whose section is on screen.
docs.scrollspy.o0: rootMargin: which part of the screen counts as current
docs.scrollspy.a0: on <nav> or a container with #id links
docs.scrollspy.a1: class of the active link (+ aria-current)
docs.stickytoc.d: Table of contents from headings: ids, list and active highlight. The one on the left is exactly this.
docs.imagelightbox.d: Image viewer: arrows, Esc, caption from alt.
docs.imagelightbox.a0: on an img or a gallery container
docs.parallax.d: Light parallax, rAF, disabled under reduced-motion.
docs.cookiebanner.d: Consent banner; the choice is stored in localStorage.
docs.skeleton.d: Skeleton placeholder until the content is ready.
docs.skeleton.o0: ms when there are no images
docs.skeleton.a1: ms, if there are no images inside
docs.typewriter.d: Typing text: word list, speed, loop, cursor. Respects reduced-motion, pauses off-screen.
docs.typewriter.a0: words separated by | (or a JSON array); empty — the element text is used
docs.typewriter.a1: ms per character, ms per deletion, pause after a word
docs.countdown.d: Countdown to a date or a timer. Unit labels are localized with Intl and follow the language.
docs.countdown.a3: your own elements instead of auto-generated ones
docs.scrollprogress.d: Reading progress for the page or a block. Accessible progressbar, CSS variable --psy-p.
docs.scrollprogress.a0: container; the bar is created for you
docs.scrollprogress.a1: selector of the block to measure (whole page by default)
docs.scrollprogress.a3: inside the container: receives the percentage
docs.compareslider.d: Before/after slider: mouse, touch, keyboard (role=slider), horizontal and vertical modes.
docs.compareslider.a0: container with two blocks or imgs: the first is “before”, the second “after”
docs.i18n.d: Dependency-free translations: JSON files, plurals, fallback, language auto-detection, RTL.
docs.i18n.a3: number for plural forms and the {n} variable
docs.i18n.a4: cycle through languages or set a specific one
docs.i18n.a5: languages, default language, file path (comma-separated for several files)
docs.core.0: Global options for any script. Priority: data attribute → PsyScripts.opts(el, …) → configure → built-in default.
docs.core.2: Options for a single element from JS (before init). Every option also works as a data-<kebab-option> attribute.
docs.core.3: Events: PsyScripts.on('toast:show', (detail, e) => e.preventDefault()); '*' — all. The same arrives as the DOM event psy:toast:show.
docs.core.4: Design tokens: flat keys apply to all themes, {light:{…}, dark:{…}, sepia:{…}} to specific ones. Keys: bg, solid, text, muted, line, ink, accent, primary, onPrimary, lav, mint, pink, peach, sky, butter, ok, err, warn, radius, border, shadow, font, mono.
docs.core.5: Replaces a built-in icon (menu, x, check, chevron-left …) with your SVG; or override the --psy-i-menu CSS variable. Class: <i class="psy-ico psy-ico--menu">.
docs.core.6: Init/destroy all scripts for dynamic content; observe watches the DOM for you (or data-psy-observe on <html>).
docs.core.7: Create your own script with the same options, attributes, init/destroy and auto-start.
